_about: Archived copy of one real NASA DONKI record (Solar Energetic Particle event). Bundled with the game; it is NOT live data.
_source: NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information), CCMC, NASA Goddard
_note: The event was detected near Earth. That it is the same event as the radiation surge Curiosity measured on Mars on 11 September 2017 (NASA JPL) is the team's inference.
